title: Raw reward-hacking direction is a token-position difference of means
claim: The paper defines a fixed-layer raw DoM vector from matched synthetic hack/honest spans and raw dot-product token scores; the listed synthetic design contains 54 conditions including four raw-only honest controls.
evidence_summary: Equation 1 averages selected positive and negative token positions. Table 3 lists 29 raw and 25 projected conditions, with honest failure/nonexecution controls and flipped-incentive counterparts.

trace.observation: v is the positive-token mean minus negative-token mean; s_t is its dot product with the selected-layer activation.
The four honest controls are raw-only; projected variants are not a second set of those controls.

independent_verification.notes: Hypatia independently reopened Equation 1 and Appendix B and verified token-position weighting, condition enumeration and raw-only controls.

limitations: This verifies the published recipe, not detector performance.
Equal token weighting is not equal conversation weighting.
The full projection and span-extraction implementation remains unresolved in F-RH-06.

title: Reward-hacking labels are contextual and consensus-selected
claim: The reference judge uses three consensus passes of the same underlying model and excludes disagreements; the generic monitor is single-pass, and positives can include considered or attempted hacks, not only completed acts.
evidence_summary: The tailored judge and generic monitor use GPT-5.6 Sol with high effort, but differ in rubric and consensus procedure. Quote repair may add calls. Operational labels do not establish subjective awareness or intent.

trace.locator: Section 2.2, Ground Truth Construction and LLM Monitor
trace.observation: Unanimous labels are retained; nonconsensus passages are excluded; quoted support must match the transcript.
Context determines whether an action violates the task; considered, attempted and enacted statuses are distinct.

independent_verification.notes: Hypatia checked the judge procedure and rubrics, including the additional quote-repair-call qualification.

limitations: Three model passes are not three independent human raters.
Excluding disputed cases changes the evaluated population.
Wrong code or task failure alone is not a reward-hacking label.

title: Published evaluation excludes probe-selection rollouts
claim: Section 4.1 selects probes using separate SWE-bench and DeepSWE rollouts, excludes those samples from evaluation, and compares detection at a generic-monitor-matched false-positive rate.
evidence_summary: The paper identifies selection pools of 250 SWE-bench and 280 DeepSWE rollouts. This supports a stated separation between selection and evaluation, not independent verification of the underlying sample manifests.

trace.observation: Highest-AUROC probe selection is described using the separate rollout pools.
Selection rollouts are excluded and the comparison uses a monitor-FPR-matched operating point.

independent_verification.notes: Hypatia independently checked selection counts, exclusion statement and matched-FPR description; it did not verify row-level IDs.

limitations: The exact layer search and calibration split are not fully specified.
Published gains are environment-dependent, not universal superiority over text monitors.
Headline performance has not been recalculated.

title: Continuation association is not demonstrated prevention
claim: The section 4.2 resampling experiment tests association between selected high probe scores and later hacking attempts; it does not evaluate a policy that prevents hacking.
evidence_summary: Eligible top-decile passages are truncated near probe peaks and resampled, with length/relative-position-matched controls. Figure 10 measures attempted hacks. No mitigation policy's success is measured there.

trace.observation: The study constructs high-score prefixes and matched controls for continuation sampling.
The endpoint concerns attempted reward hacks following resampling, not prevented failures.

independent_verification.notes: Hypatia verified the resampling procedure and the attempted-hack endpoint and found no prevention test in this experiment.

limitations: Selected prefixes are not an unbiased test of all live warnings.
Detection, prospective prediction and effective intervention require different evaluations.
Steering demonstrations elsewhere in the paper are not evidence of reduced hacking.

title: Non-SWE discovery has a held-out check but no initial general ground truth
claim: Non-SWE probe firing initially lacks original behavior labels; the paper subsequently tests probe-discovered rubrics on held-out examples with matched controls, supporting targeted discovery rather than general accuracy from firing rates.
evidence_summary: Probe selection by high firing and agreement with a generic monitor is exploratory. A separate judge and held-out rubric analysis add evidence; it would be incorrect to describe this branch as only qualitative.

trace.observation: The initial environments have no original ground-truth hack labels and use SWE-calibrated probes.
Probe-hit review generates hypotheses that are checked on held-out data against matched controls.

independent_verification.notes: Hypatia verified both the missing initial labels and the later quantitative held-out rubric check.

limitations: Judge agreement is not independent human truth.
Highest firing is a selection criterion, not AUROC.
Raw-dot versus cosine-scoring details remain unresolved.

title: Exact reward-hacking reproduction is not currently assessable
claim: The inspected materials are sufficient to identify the raw DoM method but insufficient to reconstruct and independently reproduce every published extraction, projection, calibration and performance result.

source_locators.locator: Bounded paper-link and release search on 2026-09-30

evidence_summary: No attributable author release was located in the bounded search. Required implementation and row-level material remains unlocated; this is not proof of its nonexistence.

trace.observation: Conditions are enumerated, but the exact projection transformation is not specified sufficiently.
The raw-dot recipe and cosine-similarity threshold axis require reconciliation.

trace.locator: Inspected paper links and focused searches
trace.observation: An attributable runnable release or exact artifact manifest was not identified.

independent_verification.notes: Hypatia independently checked the missing specifications and performed a bounded release search, noting author-site access failures.

limitations: Search coverage is bounded.
No performance was rerun.
A self-chosen projection would be an adaptation, not a faithful reconstruction.
unresolved_fact: Exact span masks, projection, score normalization, hook/indexing, selection/calibration IDs, runtime identities and row-level results.
validation_plan: Obtain an attributable immutable artifact bundle or author clarification. Reconcile equations and scoring, then reconstruct one raw condition before attempting projected variants or metric recomputation.

title: Released deception probe is standardized L2 logistic regression
claim: The pinned instructed-pairs configuration uses layer index 22, training-only feature scaling and logistic regression with C=0.1, random_state=42 and no fitted intercept; scoring reuses the affine transform and averages token scores by response.
evidence_summary: Source and cfg jointly resolve the executable fitting settings. The paper describes L2 lambda=10; the code maps reg_coeff=10 to C=1/reg_coeff. The score is not automatically a calibrated probability.

trace.observation: StandardScaler fits X from training activations; LogisticRegression uses C=1/reg_coeff and fit_intercept=False.
reg_coeff is 10, training is off-policy and evaluation on-policy.
Published method averages real-valued token scores for each response.

independent_verification.notes: Plato independently checked the pinned estimator, cfg and paper scoring description.

limitations: Layer index 22 must be mapped to the model's actual hidden-state convention.
This is neither a full Three-Reader nor an SAE-based primary detector.
No historical checkpoint was executed or independently authenticated.

title: Five-token and five-word masks are not equivalent
claim: The paper's last-five-token exclusion and the pinned released training-data split implement the same token boundary.
evidence_summary: The paper says tokens; the code splits on spaces and masks the final five resulting fields, ordinarily words. Word and tokenizer-token boundaries are not identical in general.

trace.observation: The described excluded tail is five tokens.
statement.split(' ') is partitioned with [:-5] and [-5:].
The prefix is detect=True; the suffix remains in the input but is detect=False.

independent_verification.notes: Plato independently compared the exact paper statement with the pinned split and mask code.

limitations: This discrepancy does not establish that the published performance is invalid.
A code-faithful versus prose-faithful replication must state which mask it uses.
No masked-token counts were independently recalculated.

title: One-percent ordinary-chat calibration is not one-percent scenario FPR
claim: The published Alpaca-control 1% threshold guarantees approximately 1% false positives among honest responses in each deception-related evaluation scenario.
evidence_summary: The threshold is the ordinary-chat control quantile. The reported example CSV gives scenario-honest FPRs of 0.25, 0.7832586169242859, 0.5 and 0.5009784698486328 at that threshold.

trace.observation: The default control population is alpaca__plain; thresholds use the control 1-FPR quantile.
Honest scenario positive rates are calculated separately at the same control threshold.

trace.locator: Roleplaying, insider report, insider confirmation, sandbagging rows

independent_verification.notes: Plato independently traced the threshold population, strict comparison, per-label aggregation and the four CSV values.

limitations: These are author-published table values, not independently recomputed metrics.
They refer to the pinned example run, not every possible detector.
Strong within-scenario AUROC can coexist with a poor transferred operating threshold.

title: Instruction-condition labels are not observed strategic intent
claim: The inspected training and evaluation labels provide a fully objective, context-independent ground truth for strategic deception.

source_locators.locator: Sections 3.2, 4.1.2 and 5.2; Appendices A, E and G

evidence_summary: The code assigns training labels by honest/dishonest directive while using the same fact prefix. Evaluation separately uses scenario-specific labels on generated responses. Ambiguity, confusion, context confounds and label uncertainty prevent the stronger interpretation.

trace.observation: Honest and dishonest conditions are interleaved and labeled by condition, not by newly observed falsehood.
Evaluation uses scenario grading; ambiguity exclusions and failure examples limit the interpretation.

independent_verification.notes: Plato independently checked condition labels and identical-prefix construction. The parent read evaluation/limitations; no independent row-level strategic-intent relabeling was performed.

limitations: Honest confession or discussion of deception can activate the probe.
A false or confused answer is not automatically a strategic lie.
Removing ambiguous cases can simplify the evaluated population.
unresolved_fact: Reliability of each released behavior label and whether ambiguous or mistaken responses change deployment performance.
validation_plan: Audit a preselected sample including ambiguous and honest same-context examples against full transcripts; publish disagreements and label sensitivity before using labels as an objective deployment standard.

title: Available code is not an independently reproduced historical run
claim: The inspected public repository establishes exact historical checkpoint provenance, reproducible metrics and permission to redistribute all upstream implementation and datasets.

source_locators.locator: Pinned repository tree, README and pyproject.toml

evidence_summary: The repository provides useful code, config and results, but no model run or score reaggregation was performed. No LICENSE file or explicit reuse grant was identified in the inspected tree; historical checkpoint/environment identity was not independently verified.

trace.observation: Readable artifacts exist; reading them is not a replayed experiment.
The inspected material did not resolve redistribution permissions.

independent_verification.notes: Plato explicitly left historical checkpoint provenance and independent metric recomputation unverified. Reuse permissions are a separate unresolved source question.

limitations: No legal determination is made.
Public visibility alone is not a reuse grant.
No pickle or upstream checkpoint was loaded.
unresolved_fact: Artifact provenance, complete pinned environment, row-level metric agreement, and applicable code/data reuse permissions.
validation_plan: First resolve license/provenance from authoritative artifacts. Then independently aggregate published score JSONs without loading checkpoints; only afterward consider an authorized isolated empirical replay.

title: Transfer to our small code model remains a hypothesis
claim: The two source methods will detect harmful misreporting or strategic deception on our pinned Qwen-1.5B model and improve code reliability.
evidence_summary: The source methods suggest low-cost fixed-layer monitors, but their original behavior distributions, models and labels differ from our task. New detection, forecasting and intervention evidence is required separately.

trace.observation: Existing local capture configuration identifies Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct, not an original paper model.
DoM requires activations obtained from the model being monitored.
The published detector is fitted to Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct; transfer to our model was not tested.

independent_verification.notes: No small-model pilot was authorized and executed during this source-only audit.

limitations: Original probe coordinates cannot simply be copied between model representation spaces.
Detecting a completed false report does not establish warning before the report or improved final code.
Free-T4 feasibility and GPU availability are not verified.
unresolved_fact: Whether a newly fitted model-specific probe generalizes beyond wording/directive cues and contributes prospective reliability gains.
validation_plan: Run the two separate small-model adaptations in REPRODUCTION-PLAN.md, in order, with matched honest controls and held-out groups. If detection is credible, preregister prefix prediction and then a fixed intervention comparison; otherwise report the limitation without changing the closed code study.
